subject: Math
text_verbatim: They then see a stall with stationary items. Bunty says, "Look, this is the 15th stall. It's 'fifteenth.'" A stall with pretty pots is next. Bunty points and says, "This is the 16th stall. We call it 'sixteenth.'" They walk to a stall with nice clothes. Bunty explains, "This one is 17th. It's 'seventeenth.'" A stall with sweet treats catches their eye. Bunty says, "Yum! This is the 18th stall. We say 'eighteenth.'" They then see a stall with shiny jewellery. Bunty tells Babloo, "This is the 19th stall. It's 'nineteenth.'" Lastly, they reach a stall with storybooks. Bunty smiles and says, "And this is the 20th stall. We call it 'twentieth.'" 21

illustrations.description: 15th stall (blue/white striped awning, brown counter): a grey eraser/sharpener block and an orange pencil.
16th stall (pink/white striped awning, brown counter): a blue swirl-patterned pot/vase and a purple cup-shaped pot.
17th stall (purple/white striped awning, brown counter): a pink/red T-shirt and a pair of green trousers.
18th stall (red/white striped awning, brown counter): a blue-wrapped candy, a green-wrapped candy, and a yellow lollipop.
19th stall (green/white striped awning, brown counter): a pink beaded necklace and a blue pendant necklace.
20th stall (blue/white striped awning, brown counter): an orange book and a purple book.
